In [[3643 BBY]], [[Serjil Javis]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] brother [[Vargai Javis|Vargai]] encountered a '''Sith apprentice''' in [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] space and a dispute broke out. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] killed Serjil and crippled Vargai, and the incident disrupted an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operation involving [[Karrels Javis]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith apprentice is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]].
